title: studio(page preview): a source page's live preview drops the page's type, so Studio draws an app or home page as a record page — no title heading, record width — while the running app draws it with both
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, class (b), a contract mismatch with a named producer and measured reach. Reader: objectui triage first-touch (grade and route).

Seam:
- Writing end that works: `@object-ui/app-shell` `views/PageView.tsx`. It hands `SchemaRenderer` `type: page.type || 'page'` **and** `pageType: page.type`. Its comment says that without `pageType` "every page fell back to `pageType: 'record'`, so non-record pages got the record max-width, a wrong `data-page-type` and a suppressed header".
- Writing end that does not: `views/metadata-admin/previews/SourcePageEditor.tsx`, `previewSchema` (about `:153`–`:156` on objectui `main` `f1781be`). It writes `{ ...draft, type: draft.type ?? 'page' }` and no `pageType`.
- Reading end: `@object-ui/components` `renderers/layout/page.tsx`, `PageRenderer`. It picks the max width and the implicit title from `pageType`.

Contract:
- `SourcePageEditor`'s own header: "a live preview rendered through the runtime SchemaRenderer".
- objectstack `docs/design/builder-ui.md` §6: "**source + live preview** for react / html pages — a code editor beside a live `SchemaRenderer` (预览即运行 · 同一渲染器 = preview *is* runtime)".

Dedupe (MCP `search_issues`, objectui, open and closed):
- The query "Studio source page preview differs from running app: no page title heading, record page width, SourcePageEditor preview pageType" returned 5 hits, all closed. The nearest is objectui#10482, about `PagePreview` reading the refused `draft.pageType` alias. That is a different writer, and the opposite direction. None describes this.
- Positive control, same run: "studio interfaces create flows list views dashboards reports pages writable package" returned objectui#11823: yes.

Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat 3 (`session_01CGZy1BGCjdN5cXqL9cnvB8`) from the objectui#11823 step-3 dev report (`6055881773`, out-of-scope finding 1, PR objectui#11932). ⛔ Not graded or routed here; ⛔ not a claim.

## What happens (measured)

- **The reading.** The dev's browser drive used published `@objectstack` 17.7.0 and the PR objectui#11932 console. Page `team_handbook` (`kind: 'html'`, `type: 'app'`) was shown both ways:
  - On Studio's Interfaces canvas, the preview has no title heading and uses the record page width.
  - In the running app's sidebar entry, the same page has the heading *Team handbook* and the app page width.
- **The source.** The seat read `SourcePageEditor.previewSchema` and `PageView`'s mapping on `main` `f1781be` (quoted above). The preview never writes `pageType`, so `PageRenderer` falls back to its record default for every source page whatever its `type` is. This affects every `html` / `react` page shown in Studio, not only new ones.

## Done when

- Every Studio surface that hands a page draft to `SchemaRenderer` writes `pageType` from the draft's `type`, as `PageView` does.
  - Enumeration nail: the `SchemaRenderer` callers under `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/` and `studio-design/` that render a page node. `SourcePageEditor` is measured.
  - `PagePreview`, `PageBlockCanvas` and `studio-canvas-preview` are not measured. Read each one, and fix any that drops `pageType`.
- A pin renders an `app` source page through `SourcePageEditor`'s preview and asserts the app width and the title heading. Control: a `record` page keeps the record layout.
- Consider whether `page-kind-writing-end-9718` should also cover the preview writers. `PageView`'s comment names it as the pin of that writing end. Its coverage of the previews was not read.
